articles.description: Delhi Police is investigating a back-dated general diary entry concerning protester actions.  The entry claims a deputy commander used plastic pellets on July twentieth. articles.title: Oman proposes Gulf-backed voluntary fees to use Hormuz
articles.description: Oman has presented Iran with a plan backed by Gulf states for managing the Strait of Hormuz. articles.title: Italy's fertility rate falls to 80-year low: Report
articles.description: Italy's birth rate fell nearly four percent last year, reaching a historic low. The fertility rate dropped to 1.14 children per woman, a significant decline. Economic pressures and a lack of support for working mothers contributed to this trend. This rate is far below the 2.1 needed for a stable population. Motherhood desires clash with job insecurity and high living costs.

articles.title: Gold, silver prices slip as Fed decision, stronger dollar keep traders cautious
articles.full_text: Silver also came under selling pressure, reflecting the broader weakness across precious metals. In the domestic market, silver prices declined by Rs 5,200 to Rs 2,24,800 per kilogram after settling at Rs 2,30,000 in the previous session. Internationally, spot silver remained relatively stable during early trade but later came under pressure, with prices dropping around 2% to nearly $57.24 per ounce. Analysts attributed the weakness to the stronger US dollar, cautious investor sentiment and anticipation surrounding the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision. While platinum managed marginal gains and palladium slipped slightly, silver's sharper decline highlighted reduced appetite for risk across the precious metals complex. A firm US dollar added to the pressure on gold prices by making dollar-denominated bullion more expensive for buyers using other currencies. The greenback hovered near a one-month high as investors positioned themselves ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy announcement. A stronger dollar typically weakens demand for gold in international markets because it raises the effective purchase cost for overseas investors. Analysts noted that currency movements remained one of the primary reasons behind the decline in precious metals, alongside cautious investor positioning before major central bank decisions. The combination of a resilient dollar and expectations of elevated interest rates reduced gold's attractiveness despite ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. Gold prices edged lower as investors largely stayed on the sidelines before the conclusion of the US Federal Reserve's two-day monetary policy meeting. Spot gold slipped 0.1% to $4,021.87 per ounce, while US gold futures for August delivery declined 0.4% to $4,021.70. Market participants expected the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged, but uncertainty over future policy continued to limit fresh buying in bullion. According to market expectations, there was a 70% probability of rates remaining steady and a 30% chance of at least a 25-basis-point increase. Traders were also pricing in a higher likelihood of a rate hike in September, making the Fed's commentary a key focus for bullion markets.

articles.title: Crude prices climb over 4% as Middle East tensions, inventory draw fuel supply fears

Military developments in the region and air strikes on militant targets heightened worries. Shipping companies operating in the Gulf remain on alert amid fears of attacks. Expectations of OPEC+ pausing production increases also lent support to prices.

articles.title: One of India's highest research honours: IIT Roorkee professor Sunil Bajpai receives the prestigious J.C. Bose Grant
articles.description: IIT Roorkee professor Sunil Bajpai has been selected for the prestigious J.C. Bose Grant by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The five-year grant recognises his outstanding scientific contributions, sustained research excellence and commitment to mentoring future researchers. Named after physicist Sir Jagadish Chandra Bose, the honour is among India’s top recognitions for scientists, engineers and technologists. The recognition highlights IIT Roorkee’s growing research impact and dedication to innovation and nation-building.

articles.title: School holidays today: State-wise update as rain closes schools in select districts
articles.description: Schools across most parts of India remain open today, July 29, 2026, as Guru Purnima is observed as a restricted holiday rather than a statewide closure. However, district administrations in Nagpur, Bageshwar, Champawat, Garhwal and Visakhapatnam have suspended classes because of heavy rainfall, landslide risks or local event management. While educational institutions in major cities continue normal operations, parents and students are advised to follow official school and district notifications for any last-minute weather-related changes.
